style.backgroundSystem: light neutral grey studio backdrop #EDEDED for on-model and info shots, clean white #FFFFFF for packshot and trust shots, cobalt blue panels #4C6FBF reserved for banner and CTA moments
style.iconSystem: thin-line icons only, single accent color
style.lightingSystem: bright soft studio lighting, front-left key with fill, soft even shadows, gentle natural daylight for street scenes
style.lockText: consistent youthful seasonal streetwear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of light neutral grey studio backdrop #EDEDED, cobalt blue banner panels #4C6FBF, charcoal text #2D2D2D and one mustard yellow accent #E8A83E, with clean white #FFFFFF kept as the base surface for packshot and trust screens; bright soft studio lighting with a front-left key and soft even shadows; bold modern geometric sans-serif headlines with oversized rotated English words as pure graphic texture; consistent rectangular banner panels and rounded info labels; consistent thin-line icon style; clean high-end apparel photography mixed with minimal editorial infographic elements; stable garment scale and centered presentation with generous even margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable front 3/4 hero angle for the garment, identical pose and lighting across variant panels, centered composition with generous even margins (clean white #FFFFFF stays available as a base surface even though it is not a palette swatch)
style.surfaceSystem: seamless paper studio backdrop and smooth matte pavement for outdoor scenes
style.typography: bold modern geometric sans-serif headlines, with oversized rotated English words used as pure graphic texture
